paite: Huan Samuel thu Israel mi tengteng lak ah athangkheta hi. Israel mite Philistia mite dou ding in akuankhia uhi. Ebenezer kiang ah panmun akhoh ua, Philistia mite'n Aphek ah panmun akhoh uhi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Suhsakna
english: The word of Samuel came to all Israel. Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle, and encamped beside Ebenezer; and the Philistines encamped in Aphek.

paite: Philistia mite Israel mite na dal ding in ana kiphalh uh. Ahong kidou uleh Philistia mite ma ah Israel mite azahlakta ua, kidouna mun ah sepaih sangli vel athat uhi.
english: The Philistines put themselves in array against Israel. When they joined battle, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men of the army in the field.

paite: Mipite agiahmun ua ava pai uleh Israel upate'n, "Bangziak in ahia tuni a TOUPA'N Philistia mite ma a hon zahlaksak mahmah? I kiang ua om a i melmate khut a pan hon hondam ding in Shiloh a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm i va la ding uh," achi uhi.
english: When the people had come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, “Why has Yahweh defeated us today before the Philistines? Let’s get the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of Shiloh and bring it to us, that it may come among us and save us out of the hand of our enemies.”

paite: Huchi in mipite'n Shiloh ah mi asawl ua, huai a pan cherubim tung a tu sepaihte' TOUPA thukhun bawm ava la ua; huai ah Pathian thukhun bawm toh Eli tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas a-om uhi.
english: So the people sent to Shiloh, and they brought from there the ark of the covenant of Yahweh of Armies, who sits above the cherubim; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thukhun bawm agiahmun uh ahong tun in, Israel mi tengteng ngaihtak in akikou zuazua ua, lei nangawn athawn ging zuazua hi.
english: When the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth resounded.

paite: Philistia mite'n akikou husa uh azak un, "Hebrute giahmun a kikou husa gingta zuazua mai bang chihna ahia le?" achi uh. Agiahmun uah TOUPA thukhun bawm ahong tung ahi, chih atheita uhi.
english: When the Philistines heard the noise of the shout, they said, “What does the noise of this great shout in the camp of the Hebrews mean?” They understood that Yahweh’s ark had come into the camp.

paite: Philistia, "Giahmun ah Pathian ahong hi," achih ziak un mite'n alau uhi. "I tung agik hi! Tuma lam in huchibang a-om ngei ngal kei a, achi uhi.
english: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.

paite: I tung agik hi! Huai Pathiante khut hattak a pan kua'n ahia hon hondam ding? Huai Pathiante ahi, Aigupta mite gamdai a hipi chiteng a that.
english: Woe to us! Who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty gods? These are the gods that struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the wilderness.

paite: Aw, nou Philistia mite aw, nou sikha ua a-om bang ua nou Hebrute sikha a na omlouhna ding un hattak in om unla, kipasalsak un. Kipasalsak unla sual un," achi uhi.
english: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”

paite: Huchi in Philistia mite'n asual ua, Israel mite azahlaksak ua, michih apuanin lam chiat uah ataikek uh. Anak thah mahmah ua, Israelte sepaih singthum asi uhi.
english: The Philistines fought, and Israel was defeated, and each man fled to his tent. There was a very great slaughter; for thirty thousand footmen of Israel fell.

paite: Pathian bawm alaksak ua, Eli tapa nih, Hophni leh Phinehas leng athat uhi.
english: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

paite: Sepaih lak a Benjamin suan mi khat atai a, apuan khawng kikek nengnung in leh alu a lei kai niaunuau in huai ni mahmah in Shiloh ava tung hi.
heading: Eli Sihna
english: A man of Benjamin ran out of the army and came to Shiloh the same day, with his clothes torn and with dirt on his head.

paite: Ahong tun in, ngai in, Eli in lampi gei a tutna a tu kawm in ana en nilouh a, Pathian bawm ziak in alungtang aling ngal a. Mipa'n khua atun a tanchin agenleh akhomi teng akapkhia uhi.
english: When he came, behold, Eli was sitting on his seat by the road watching, for his heart trembled for God’s ark. When the man came into the city and told about it, all the city cried out.

paite: Eli in akikou husa uh azak in, "Tua thawm ging vengvung bang chihna ahia?" achi hi. Mi khat kintak in ava hoh a, Eli ava hilh hi.
english: When Eli heard the noise of the crying, he said, “What does the noise of this tumult mean?” The man hurried, and came and told Eli.

paite: Eli bel kum sawmkua-le-giat a upa ahi a, amit amialta a, khua amu thei nawn kei.
english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.

paite: Huai mipa'n Eli kiang ah, "Sepaih lak a pan hong paikhia ka hi. Tuni a sepaih lak a pan hong taikhia ka hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka tapa, bangchibang in thil a-om a oi?" achi hi.
english: The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter go, my son?”

paite: Tanchin hon tunpa'n adawng a, "Israel mite Philistia mite ma ah ataikek ua, mipi lak ah kithahna thupitak a-om lai a, na tapate nih Hophni leh Phinehas leng asi ua, Pathian bawm leng alaksak uh," achi hi.
english: He who brought the news answered, “Israel has fled before the Philistines, and there has been also a great slaughter among the people. Your two sons also, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and God’s ark has been captured.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian bawm thu agentak in kongpi bul a tutphah a pan athalpuk a, amah tekta a kikhouh zou nawn lou ahih ziak in, angawng akitan a, asita hi. Israel tung ah kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.
english: When he made mention of God’s ark, Eli fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.

paite: Amounu, Phinehas zi in nau apai a, neih ahun mahmahta hi. Ama'n Pathian bawm laksak ahih thu leh apu leh apasal si uh ahi chih azak in akunsuk a, nauvei nat in apha a, ta aneita hi.
heading: Phinehas Zi Sihna
english: His daughter-in-law, Phinehas’ wife, was with child, near to giving birth. When she heard the news that God’s ark was taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and gave birth; for her pains came on her.

paite: Asih dek lai in akiang a dingh numeite'n akiang ah, "Lau ke'n, tapa na neita," achi uhi. Himahleh adawng het kei a, alimsak sam kei hi.
english: About the time of her death the women who stood by her said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for you have given birth to a son.” But she didn’t answer, neither did she regard it.

paite: "Thupina in Israel apawtsanta," chi in nau min Ikabod asa hi. Pathian bawm lah alaksakta ua, apa leh apasal lah asita ngal ua.
english: She named the child Ichabod, saying, “The glory has departed from Israel!” because God’s ark was taken, and because of her father-in-law and her husband.

paite: "Thupina in Israel apawtsanta, Pathian bawm lah alaksakta ngal ua," achi hi.
english: She said, “The glory has departed from Israel; for God’s ark has been taken.”
